purpose: WORK_QUEUE section 1 item 3: an alpha sweep for the operator to choose three live-run points from. These are OFFLINE-evaluation artifacts; the frontier-scored sdp-v3 strategy refuses an out-of-window artifact.

anchor_check.verdict: MATCH - the anchor reproduces sdp_policy_v6.json's policy block

refinement.purpose: Second sweep: five alpha points on each side of each of the two behaviour-transition boundaries the first sweep bracketed, so both regimes are sampled five times within 8 % of the transition.

spacing.note: geometric deltas, x2 per step; the pair straddling a boundary differs by 1 % in alpha, the outermost pair by 16 %.

degeneracy.name: degeneracy
degeneracy.predicate: the solved share map is non-degenerate: at least one cell commands share > 0
degeneracy.method: geometric bisection on log(alpha) through sdp_ems_solver.main(); both bracket ends verified first

charge.name: charge
charge.predicate: at least one policy cell selects charge_goal > 0
charge.method: geometric bisection on log(alpha) through sdp_ems_solver.main(); both bracket ends verified first
